assumptions_and_limits: Python tempfile random candidate name length8 on pinned CPython3.12. Prefixes ck-,tmp,modular-verify-,fdd-,nested-release-,run-budget- are read from producers. No platform long-path setting assumed.
time.time_ns() represented conservatively by20 decimal digits for predeclared 2026 campaign; arbitrary user run names are absent. Fresh fixture/arm directories prevent runner collision suffixes.

Ordinary source CLI/smoke fixtures use max-experiments1. Therefore no global-ensemble selection path or HPO depth is composed beneath their long smoke/multi-target prefixes. Direct ensemble/view tests have only bounded one/two component levels under short generic roots.

B9 four-leaf tests mock students and recurse at most global parent component plus feature-view component. B8 default tests mock run_worker, so selected four-leaf metadata does not create fresh child fit artifact directories.

Analysis fixtures use bounded control/candidate fold labels, v11-featureviews1/v16-mean1 and classification/regression prefixes, prepared-search/prepared-confirmation/passport. Compiled standalone helper copies are flat68 names.

JSON atomic suffix.tmp and submission.csv.tmp are included where the actual producer uses them; np.savez probability files are direct writes, not fabricated .npz.tmp. validation_probabilities.npz28 is the longest worker output basename in these fixture branches.

Coordinator children inherit PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE1; both registered isolated -I child commands also pass explicit-B. Therefore no __pycache__/atomic.pyc path is materialized by the declared gate commands. Reaudit if interpreter flags/environment change.

Source checks MPLCONFIGDIR is explicit shallow gate output/mpl; fixed font cache/lock shown. CatBoost adapters disallow training-file output. Arbitrary undocumented optional third-party cache roots are outside this static saved-source claim.

All46 inherited registered scripts and both new B scripts were read/AST-inventoried as source. AST inventory is not test execution and does not qualify ML, source gates, API closure, process cleanup or output write success.
